title: Our vision
slide_intent: Show how an aspirational statement relates to present-day work. A reader can distinguish what the organization wants to change from how it works.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can express one shared vision while giving partners concrete language for explaining the organization.
demonstration: A large statement about a future free from AIDS sits above three ruled rows for why the organization exists, what it does and how it works.
practical_value: Lead a presentation with the vision, then select the explanatory row that answers the audience’s question.

content_islands.name: Heading and orientation
content_islands.spec: Use the section rail and narrow introduction column at left.

content_islands.name: Vision and explanations
content_islands.spec: Set the vision in large uppercase type at right. Align the three smaller labels and supporting explanations below it on common column edges.
